palette: armory midnight navy, spearhead silver, shield crimson, parchment cream, brass ring gold, moss green, graphite ink
typography: WenKai headings on brass-bound shield bosses, etched condition lines and crimson wax verdicts
composition: a central armory aisle with twin spear-shield racks; request lanes, fork benches and a three-stand defence wall occupy the hall
surface: steel plates, parchment cards, leather straps, crimson wax seals
motion: spear tokens thrust along request lanes, shield tokens rise to meet them; claim tickets travel forks and settle as sealed terminal states
transition: the armory floor, banner rail and steel racks persist while the racks and stands are re-dressed between scenes
